caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall, cylindrical bottle made of what appears to be reddish-brown ceramic or clay. The bottle has a narrow, short neck and a small, rounded handle attached from the neck to the upper body, near the top. The bottle's surface shows subtle variations in tone, with lighter and darker areas suggesting highlights and shadows, and a few small marks or scuffs indicating texture. There is a faint horizontal ridge around the middle of the bottle, dividing it into two sections. The background is plain and consists of a uniform light beige color, with no additional objects or decorations present, focusing attention solely on the bottle.
